basic_profile.headline: Technical Product Management | Product Ownership | E-commerce & Payments | IIM Mumbai EMBA | 6+ Years in Digital Products & Engineering
basic_profile.name: Ayushi Kushwaha
basic_profile.summary:
Hey there,

I am Ayushi, currently working as a Senior Backend Software Engineer for Falabella Ecommerce company. Previously, I have worked for one of the leading airlines globally, Delta Airlines . Prior to Delta, I had the opportunity to work with one of the big four firms, Deloitte. With Deloitte, I gained expertise in several technologies, including Kotlin, Reactive Programming, and Spring Framework, Gradle, Swagger, JWT, Apache Camel. A full-stack developer, I'm proficient in Java, Maven, spring framework, spring Webflux, Kotlin.

During my final year in college, I was offered a paid internship at the FinTech company Highradius Corporation, which provides Software-as-a-Service. I gained knowledge of different marketing and sales strategies. I was also responsible for Account-Based Marketing.

I am a versatile and quick learner with a broad range of experience in both the technical and marketing fields. Having an experience of more than two years, I am a technical enthusiast who enjoys exploring new domains and technologies.

current.description: Product-focused technology professional and IIM Mumbai EMBA candidate with 6+ years of experience building scalable digital products across e-commerce, payments, order management and airline loyalty. Experienced in requirement discovery, customer journey analysis, product prioritization, stakeholder management, technical feasibility and translating business problems into scalable solutions. Targeting Technical Product Manager, Product Owner and Platform Product roles.
